confidence_floor.applies_to: CNN judgements (F02-F06, F08, F11, F13-F15, F18) and numeric F07, F12; the measurement features F01, F09, F10, F17 use their own hold rule; F20 / F21 are not held

candidate: every requirement condition met by a judged feature (alternatives joined by 또는, all atoms of an alternative)
G: single feature: its score; several: geometric mean of the scores
order: candidates sorted by G descending (no forced last tier for F11 or any passage); ties: representative id
round: walk the sorted list and take a passage if none of its regions has been taken in this round and it does not exceed unfavourable_max; a passage covering two regions uses both turns
when no further passage can be taken in a round, start a new round with the remaining passages; stop at total or when a round takes nothing
previous_rule: until 2026-11-16: one list by G, same region <= 3, unfavourable <= 2, total 5 (e2e_v13.json "current selection")
depth_features: F20, F21 from depth_models.json (돌출됨 -> 높음 / 나옴, 돌출안됨 -> 보통), not held by the confidence floor
nose_features: F09 코 길이 and F10 코 높이 (renamed from 코끝 돌출) from nose_measures.json: numeric, held when the boundary score is below 0.755 (within one sigma of a cut); cuts = 33% / 67% of the 400-person rank (user, 2026-11-16)
eye_features: F01 눈 크기 from eye_measures.json (candidate 10: eye width and picture-read opening over sqrt(face area below the brows)): numeric, held when the boundary score is below 0.755; the picture-read opening is in eye_dark.py (dark_opening) and the face area in eye_page.py (face_below_brows) - code to port
jaw_features: F17 턱 폭 from jaw_measures.json (angle at the chin tip 152 between the jaw corners 172 / 397, frontal 2D landmarks; not pitch-adjusted): numeric, held when the boundary score is below 0.755; the face CNN is not used (the face crop is still needed as the context tile of the other parts)
